units.source_text: 只此有名无实之事，是我不可逃遁之罪。”

en.t: This affair, which has the name but not the reality, is a sin from which I cannot escape.

units.source_text: 深恐送信时在途中有被人拆看之危险，故不再细写。

en.t: I deeply fear that if I send a letter, someone may open and read it on the way, so I will not write any more details.
